envelope.description: Carry the provider's error text on done ok:false and treat it as a failure

body.title: Carry the provider's error text on done ok:false and treat it as a failure
body.summary: Add the optional message field to the done TurnEvent in stream-events.ts; make the claude result mapper (cli-adapter.ts ~:655) set it from obj.result when is_error is true and the codex result mapper (~:781) set it from the error text; carry it through both doneEvent wrappers (live and resumed) with the session id; make onTerminal in chat-panel.ts treat done with ok:false as a failure (q.error = message, or 'the turn ended with an error' when there is none) so settleQueued resolves failed. This alone turns a failed claude or codex turn from done into failed before any retry exists, adds a regression test so it cannot be recorded as done again, and finds and updates every existing test that pinned the old done behaviour (named in the build summary).
acceptanceChecks: a claude result with is_error carries its text on done ok:false, a codex error result does too, and a successful result has no message
a queued turn ending with done ok:false resolves failed with the text, not done
every existing consumer of done renders as before (the field is additive)
a regression test fails if an is_error result is recorded as done again
every existing test that pinned the old behaviour (an is_error result resolving done) is found and updated in this task, and the build summary names them

tests.name: cli-adapter.test.ts: a claude result with is_error carries its text on done ok:false, a codex error result does too, and a successful result has no message
chat-queue-runner.test.ts: a queued turn that ends with done ok:false resolves failed with the text, not done
